intro: Kali Remik is a Darkspear troll hunter who spends her time lending guidance to travelers across the Horde's heartland. Familiar with the ways of tracking and survival in Durotar, she directs young hunters to Thotar in Razor Hill to learn the taming of beasts.

p: Kali Remik is a seasoned jungle troll tracker well-acquainted with the arid wastes of Durotar and the bustling hubs of the Horde. In coastal settlements like Sen'jin Village, she watches over young scouts taking their first steps outside the Valley of Trials. Knowing when a novice outgrows the local training grounds, she steps in to direct promising marksmen toward Thotar in Razor Hill to begin their path as beastmasters, ensuring the Horde's frontier ranks stay sharp and disciplined.
